LisCredit Marketplace

Bring qualified demand and the right capital together.

Discuss a deployment↗See how it works ↓

LisCredit is marketplace infrastructure for bringing multiple sources of qualified demand and multiple capital providers into one controlled operating environment. It can be deployed as a marketplace, embedded in an existing platform or connected to participating providers.

Who it is for

Marketplace operators, banks, lenders, funds, fintechs and platforms that want to launch, embed or participate in a controlled credit marketplace.

The system in action

See the work
change state.

01

The situation

Qualified people and businesses need suitable capital, while providers need relevant demand that fits their own products and rules.

02

The system at work

LisCredit brings qualified demand, applicable products, provider routes, offers and origination workflows into one governed marketplace journey.

03

The outcome

Operators see both sides of the market, providers see relevant opportunities and qualified applicants see the routes available to them.

Agree what success looks like

Make the improvement visible.

Qualified demand; provider participation; relevant matches; time to provider decision; origination progress.

Measures are agreed for each deployment. They are not guaranteed results.

Both sides of the market

Qualified demand.
Participating capital.

LisCredit creates the marketplace relationship after trust and eligibility. It does not manufacture trust and it does not take over the capital provider's decision or risk.

Launch a marketplace

Deploy LisCredit for an operator or institution, with its own products, rules, participants and operating model.

Embed LisCredit

Place the qualified-demand-to-capital journey inside an existing platform through approved integrations.

Join as a provider

Connect products and authorised workflows so relevant qualified opportunities can progress under the provider’s own rules.

Commercial routes

Deploy. Embed.
Participate.

AlphaIT can provide marketplace deployment, integration, annual platform licensing, support, usage-based infrastructure and institution-specific extensions.

Provider onboarding, distribution arrangements and transaction or success fees are used only where the applicable market, contract and regulatory position allow them.

LSI establishes governed evidence. LTI governs trust and eligibility. LisCredit operates where qualified demand meets capital.

From fit to deployment

Your work.
Your requirements.

We confirm the people, data, connections, authority and operating conditions required. Then we agree scope, delivery stages, acceptance checks and support.

Where the ready system does not fully fit, AlphaIT can engineer the missing connection or capability.

Credit providers retain their decisions and capital risk. Deployment is subject to applicable law, agreed policy and the authority of each participating institution.
